rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. Where the printed steps say STOP (Steps 1 to 5) or line 4 is Yes (line 5 skipped) or line 2 is zero, the model leaves the later Worksheet A lines blank; the project computes every line regardless and applies eligibility in eic.credit, which Form 1040 line 27a reads (zero when a step stops). In an ordinary evaluation the worksheet lines are not reached on an ineligible return; line 6 agrees on every case.
